title: Rabin-Karp: All Pattern Occurrences
statement:
Given a text string T and a pattern string P, find all starting indices (0-indexed) where P occurs as a substring in T using the Rabin-Karp rolling hash algorithm.

Rabin-Karp computes a polynomial hash for the pattern and slides a same-length window across the text, recomputing the hash in O(1) per step. On a hash match, verify with a direct character comparison to avoid false positives.

Print all starting indices in ascending order, one per line. If no occurrence exists, print -1.
constraints:
1 <= |P| <= |T| <= 10^5
Both strings consist of lowercase English letters only.
inputFormat:
Line 1: the text T.
Line 2: the pattern P.
outputFormat: All 0-indexed starting positions where P occurs in T, one per line, in ascending order. Print -1 if none.
